page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. With a 1:8 ratio of processing cores to memory, the instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe storage or onboard GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage options. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps to support data transfer requirements. The dedicated CPU allocation model ensures that each of the 32 vCPUs maps to a physical core without hyperthreading, delivering consistent compute performance for workloads that require predictable execution times.

The high memory-to-vCPU ratio makes the ecs.r8i.8xlarge cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local storage or GPU acceleration. It is designed for enterprise databases, in-memory caching layers, large-scale data processing, and enterprise resource planning systems.
